map.name: Ostrel
map.trouble: Vorlath, a renegade wizard, holds the Observatory above the College of Ostrel and has turned the College's Stone Golems on the town.

bounty_offer.specifics: Mabeth, the College cook, pays to have the Imps' nest in the old cistern burned out.

offer.speaker: Mabeth
offer.text:
Pardon the mess, lad, but the Imps were through my kitchen again last night. They come up out of the old cistern under the College, and every time there's more of them.

That nest has to be burned out, but the little devils have blocked the cistern stair behind them. Gorwin the porter knows another way down. Take this shield. Imps throw whatever they can lift.

reminder.speaker: Mabeth
reminder.text: That shield will come in handy once the Imps start throwing pots. Gorwin can show you the way down. Good luck and be careful!

completion.speaker: Mabeth
completion.text: I'm sure the Masters will be glad to have their suppers back on the table. Here's 100 gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Imps are raiding the College kitchen -- find their nest and burn it out!

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Master Quillan wants the Ward Stone back from the Urchins who broke into the College vault.

offer.speaker: Quillan
offer.text:
Thunder and blazes! Are you the help Yarrick promised us?! Urchins got into the College vault in the storm, and they'd have carried off the whole of it if old Hobb hadn't come down with his lamp and screamed the house awake!

But in all the noise the thieves made off with the Ward Stone! Without it every ward on this town is down, and Vorlath can walk right in!

Never mind the silver they took, I want the Stone, and those Urchins made to pay! They've gone south, into the Sinkholes. Will you go after them, lad?

refusal.speaker: Quillan
refusal.text: Then return when you've found your nerve.

reminder.speaker: Quillan
reminder.text: That Stone is all that stands between us and Vorlath! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Quillan
completion.text:
In better times the bells of the College would ring all night for a deed like this! Well done! But Vorlath is still out there, and he won't wait for us.

This gold and this Spell Book are yours, with the thanks of the whole College! And the Library is open to you from now on. Tell the porter I said so.

journal.text: Recover the Ward Stone from the Urchins in the Sinkholes.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Ward Stone from the Urchins in the Sinkholes.

two_givers.specifics: Master Tessaly sends the player to Fennick's workshop for her Focus Crystal. Zabble, a student, pays to have his summoned Bats cleared before the Masters find out.

offer_a.speaker: Tessaly
offer_a.text:
Wanderer! You must hurry to Fennick's workshop by the east wall! Fennick was making me a Focus Crystal, and I haven't had a word from him since Vorlath's Golems came over the bridge. I would go myself, but I spent the last of my mana holding them off and I can't so much as light a candle. Bring me the Crystal, and see if Vorlath has been there. You'll know if he has.

And careful! Fennick keeps traps for thieves.

outcome_a.speaker: Tessaly
outcome_a.text:
The Crystal! Oh, wonderful! Thank you, I didn't think anyone could get past Fennick's traps!

So Vorlath was there first. Poor Fennick... We have no time to mourn him. Take these potions, they'll do you more good than me. Now, I must get to work.

journal_a.text: Go to Fennick's workshop and bring back the Focus Crystal.

offer_b.speaker: Zabble
offer_b.text:
Psst! Greetings. I am Zabble. Student of Summoning at the College, second year, maybe third. I tried a little summoning in my room and now it's full of Bats. I chased them out with a broom and they flew right back in!

You must get them out before the Masters make their rounds. Here is the key to my room, top of the east stair. Don't let any into the hall!

outcome_b.speaker: Zabble
outcome_b.text: Many thanks friend. You've done me a kindness, one the Masters will never hear about, I hope. Take this gold. I insist.

journal_b.text: Clear the Bats out of Zabble's room in the College.

rescue.specifics: Master Orlo begs the player to bring his pupil Nimrel up from the Proving Vaults, where Vorlath's Shades have got in.

plea.speaker: Orlo
plea.text:
Welcome to Ostrel, kind sir! We've been hoping for a stout pair of arms for days!

My pupil Nimrel, a fine singer too, went down into the Proving Vaults for her final trial and never came up! No student has ever been kept down there this long. Vorlath's Shades must have got in.

Go down into the Vaults under the west court and bring Nimrel out. Then come and find me. I'll be in the lecture hall, as always.

reminder.speaker: Orlo
reminder.text: Those wretched Shades get bolder every week.

found.speaker: Nimrel
found.text: Keep back, or I'll burn you!

following.speaker: Nimrel
following.text: Filthy Shades! You'll never hold me down here again!

completion.speaker: Orlo
completion.text:
Nimrel! Back safe! Thank you! The whole College owes you a debt it won't forget.

Here, take this robe. Ysolde sells them for 200 gold or more, but you've earned it twice over. Archmage Dorvanis has been asking for you. Go and see him in the Chapter House straight away.

journal.text: Bring Nimrel back up from the Proving Vaults

main_opening.specifics: Krumm points the player to Archmage Dorvanis, barred in the Chapter House, who hands over the Observatory key and sends him after Vorlath.

herald.speaker: Krumm
herald.text: We must get help to Archmage Dorvanis in the Chapter House and drive these Golems out of our College!

opening.speaker: Dorvanis
opening.text: Yarrick's friend? Thank goodness! Vorlath's Golems are loose in the courts and I've had to bar myself in. Here, I'll push the Observatory key under the door. Stop Vorlath before he wakes every Golem we own!

reminder.speaker: Dorvanis
reminder.text: Every Golem he wakes is another one at my door. Off you go!

journal.text: Enter the Observatory and stop Vorlath.
